motion.name: tab-switch
motion.purpose: Bottom menu selection and page transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action, 48dp on phones and 56dp on TV.
components.css: .ds-button { min-height:48px; padding:0 16px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid #01C4FA; color:#01C4FA; background:#161b1d; font:600 14px system-ui; cursor:pointer; transition:background 220ms ease-out; } .ds-button:hover, .ds-button:focus-visible { background:#01C4FA22; } .ds-button:active { background:#01C4FA44; } .ds-button:disabled { opacity:.45; cursor:default; }

components.name: Content Card
components.css: .ds-card { padding:16px; border-radius:16px; color:#f1f3f4; background:#242a2d; font:400 14px system-ui; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Filled field with visible focus and error outline.
components.css: .ds-input { min-height:48px; padding:0 16px; border-radius:12px; border:1px solid transparent; color:#f1f3f4; background:#30373a; font:400 14px system-ui; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #01C4FA; outline-offset:0; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity:.45; }

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: Floating phone navigation pill with selected destination label and 48dp targets in every theme.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:8px; padding:8px; border-radius:16px; background:#242a2d; } .ds-nav-item { min-height:48px; padding:0 12px; border:0; border-radius:8px; color:#f1f3f4; background:transparent; cursor:pointer; } .ds-nav-item[aria-current], .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { color:#01C4FA; background:#01C4FA22; } .ds-nav-item:active { background:#01C4FA44; }

components.name: Selection Chip
components.description: Status filter with an outlined selected state.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height:48px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid #657075; border-radius:8px; color:#f1f3f4; background:transparent; font:600 14px system-ui; cursor:pointer; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed=true], .ds-chip:hover, .ds-chip:focus-visible { border-color:#01C4FA; color:#01C4FA; background:#01C4FA22; } .ds-chip:active { background:#01C4FA44; }

narrative.overview: Anime artwork leads. Shared Material color roles, clear type, and restrained control states keep the interface consistent across phone and TV.
keyCharacteristics: Custom dark theme is the default
Cyan, Violet, and Forest light and dark presets are selectable
dos: Keep phone touch targets at least 48dp.
donts: Do not let navigation labels overflow narrow screens.
